en.headline: Sincere to close its Central store in early December
en.dek: The company said talks to renew the lease at 189 Des Voeux Road Central failed, and the lease ends on 31 December.
body: Sincere Company Limited said its Central department store will stop trading in early December after it failed to agree a new lease with the landlord.

In a voluntary announcement dated 4 October, the company said it had wanted to renew the lease on the ground-floor shop at 189 Des Voeux Road Central, which expires on 31 December 2026, but no agreement was reached. The store will close around the start of December, after which the company will reinstate the premises and hand them back.

Sincere said it still intends to open another department store in Central or Sheung Wan, but had not found a site by the date of the announcement. Until then it will keep the Mong Kok store on the fourth floor of King Wah Centre at 628 Nathan Road, and its online shop. Outside the department-store business, it also runs outdoor-apparel shops in Tin Shui Wai and Wong Tai Sin.

Directors expect group sales to fall because of the Central closure alone. They said operating losses could narrow because rent and other costs will be saved, and the group plans to put more resources into a wider product range, buying, online retail and a brand refresh.

zh.headline: 先施中環店將於12月初停業
zh.dek: 先施表示未能與業主就德輔道中189號地下店續租達成協議，租約於12月31日屆滿。
body: 先施有限公司公布，中環百貨店將於12月初左右停業，原因是未能與業主就續租達成協議。
公司在10月4日的自願公告說，德輔道中189號地下店的租約將於2026年12月31日屆滿，公司有意續租但不果。店舖將於12月初左右停止營業，其後進行還原工程並交還業主。
先施表示，仍擬在中環或上環另覓地方開設百貨公司，截至公告發布之日尚未找到合適場所。期間會繼續經營旺角彌敦道628號瓊華中心四樓的百貨店，以及網上商店。百貨業務以外，集團亦在天水圍和黃大仙經營戶外運動服裝門市。
董事預期，集團整體銷售會因中環店歇業而下降；但租金及其他開支減少，經營虧損或有所收窄。集團計劃把更多資源投放在產品多元化及採購、線上零售和品牌重塑。
